package.description: PDF Protection and Digital Rights Management

en-US.description: PDF Protection and Digital Rights Management
en-US.longDescription: Drumlin Publisher software enables you to convert your PDF files to our secure strongly encrypted format, with the permission settings you require. Files are converted locally, so the source PDFs never leave your site, only reference data is stored on our central Digital Rights Management (DRM) service. You can then distribute/sell the secured file(s) via emails, web download links or on physical media to your end users/customers/employees and our Digital Rights Management (DRM) service will check that the user is allowed to view that document via a system of authorization codes or licenses
en-US.name: DrumlinPublisher

zh-CN.description: PDF 保护和数字版权管理
zh-CN.longDescription: Drumlin Publisher 软件能够将您的 PDF 文件转换为高度加密的安全格式，并按照您所需的权限设置进行保护。文件转换过程在本地完成，源 PDF 文件始终不会离开您的设备，仅需将参考数据存储于我们的中央数字版权管理（DRM）服务中。随后，您可通过电子邮件、网页下载链接或物理介质向终端用户/客户/员工分发或销售加密文件，我们的数字版权管理（DRM）服务将通过授权码或许可证系统验证用户是否具备文档访问权限。
